news.speaker: NWS Boston forecast discussion
news.text:
.AVIATION /18Z SUNDAY THROUGH THURSDAY/...
Forecast Confidence Levels:

Low - less than 30 percent.
Moderate - 30 to 60 percent.
High - greater than 60 percent.

Rest of Today:

Snow and sleet have mostly ended with just rain showers with
freezing rain in isolated spots in the high terrain. IFR/LIFR
CIGS continue through the afternoon. Wind shear picks up from
the SW this afternoon, especially near coastal areas. Winds
over the Cape and the Islands could briefly become very gusty
out of the SW late this afternoon to early this evening at 40-50
knots.

Tonight:

Cold front sweeps the remaining precip and IFR CIGS offshore
this evening from west to east between 23z-02z. CIGS quickly pop
up to MVFR then VFR. Winds turn west and become gusty around
30-40 knots.

Sunday:

VFR and very windy. Winds gusting 40-50 knots, possibly up to 60
knots in the elevated terrain and near the Cape and Islands.

Sunday Night:

VFR. Winds remain strong out of the west at 35-45 knots.

KBOS TAF...Moderate Confidence

IFR/LIFR. Periods of moderate to heavy rain this afternoon.
Wind shear from the SW increase this afternoon to 40-60 knots.
Cold front moves through around 01z lifting CIGS back to VFR and
drying out any remaining rain showers. Very windy behind the
cold front with west winds gusting 40-50 knots through Monday
night.

KBDL TAF...Moderate confidence .

IFR/LIFR. Periods of moderate to heavy rain this afternoon.
Wind shear from the SW increase this afternoon to 30-50 knots.
Cold front moves through around 23z lifting CIGS back to VFR and
drying out any remaining rain showers. Very windy behind the
cold front with west winds gusting 40-50knots through Monday
night.

Outlook /Monday Night through Thursday/...

Monday Night: VFR. Strong winds with gusts up to 45 kt.

Tuesday: VFR. Strong winds with areas of gusts up to 40 kt.

Tuesday Night: VFR. Windy with gusts up to 35 kt.

Wednesday: VFR. Breezy.

Wednesday Night: VFR. Slight chance SN.

Thursday: Mainly VFR, with local IFR possible. Breezy. Chance
SN.

news.speaker: NWS Boston forecast discussion
news.text:
.AVIATION /12Z SUNDAY THROUGH THURSDAY/...

Forecast Confidence Levels:

Low - less than 30 percent.
Moderate - 30 to 60 percent.
High - greater than 60 percent.

Today...High confidence on trends, lower on exact timing.

IFR/LIFR across the region with mixed precip and rain along the
south coast, snow with -FZDZ possible BDL/BAF/ORH/BED. Then all
sites transition to snow, light to moderate 16-23Z, except
18-21Z for Cape Cod and Islands. ENE winds up to 35 kt along
the coast, shift to NNE this afternoon and remain gusty.

Tonight...High confidence on trends, lower on exact timing of
improving conditions.

MVFR/IFR to start with any lingering snow tapering off, but will
take the longest for the Cape/Islands. Should improve to VFR by
roughly 03-09Z from west to east. Strong gusty NNW winds up to
40 kt across Cape Cod and Islands, slowly diminishing overnight.

Monday...High confidence.

VFR with diminishing winds and dry weather.

KBOS TAF...Moderate confidence.

Rain/snow mix through the morning with temps rising to 33-35F.
Then changes over to light/moderate snow 16-18Z with
accumulating snow until about 21-23Z. Then light snow/flurries
tapering off 00-03Z. Strong ENE winds up to 30 kt this morning,
shifts to NNE this afternoon, then NNW this evening and
remaining gusty.

KBDL TAF...Moderate confidence.

Light to moderate snows throughout the day, but could have brief
periods of -FZDZ through roughly 15Z. Confidence too low at this
point to include in the TAF. NNE winds shift to the N later
today and NW tonight.

Outlook /Monday Night through Thursday/...

Monday Night: VFR. Breezy.

Tuesday: Mainly VFR, with local IFR possible. Windy with local
gusts up to 30 kt. Chance RA, chance SN.

Tuesday Night: Mainly IFR, with local MVFR possible. Strong
winds with gusts up to 60 kt. RA, chance SN.

Wednesday: Mainly VFR, with local IFR possible. Strong winds
with gusts up to 60 kt. Chance RA.

Wednesday Night: VFR. Windy with gusts up to 35 kt.

Thursday: VFR. Breezy.
